description: §15.10.1 (S458 fourth round, F3) — by-value prop `n=@v` (7): a destructured local / parameter / loop binder named `n` reads its OWN value — `const { n }`, `const [n]`, `function f({ n })`, `f([n])`, `f(a, { n })`, `for (const [k, n] …)`, `for (const { n } …)`, `for (const [n, m] …)` — and `function f({ n }) { n = n + 1 }` writes the parameter (no E-ASSIGN-004, @v untouched). Outside them `n` is the prop. Before the fix every position read the caller's 7 (out was 8,8,7,7,8,7,7,12,8,8 and @v became 8).
rationale: §15.10.1 Shadowing: a local declaration, a lambda/function parameter and a `for-stmt` loop variable shadow a same-named prop in their scopes; a destructuring pattern binds every name in it.
